tools.name: airports__airport
tools.description: An airport by ICAO, IATA or ident: name, type, town, country and region, location, elevation, runways and frequencies. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: airports__search
tools.description: Find airports by name or town and/or country, optionally by type or scheduled service only; biggest first. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: airports__near
tools.description: Airports (large/medium/small by default) within a radius of a point or UK postcode, nearest first. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: airports__runways
tools.description: An airport's runways: length, width, surface, lighting and each end's identifier, heading and elevation. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: airports__frequencies
tools.description: An airport's radio frequencies (tower, ground, ATIS, approach…) in MHz. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: airports__country
tools.description: Airport counts by type, the large airports and the regions for a country. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: airports__navaids-near
tools.description: VORs, NDBs, DMEs and other navaids within a radius of a point, with frequency and associated airport. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__tube-status
tools.description: Live status of every Tube line. A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__mode-status
tools.description: Live status of every line for a mode (tube, overground, elizabeth-line, dlr, tram, bus). A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__line-status
tools.description: Live status and disruption for one line. A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__line-arrivals
tools.description: Live arrival predictions for every stop on a line. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__stop-arrivals
tools.description: Live arrival predictions at a stop or station. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__stop-search
tools.description: Find stations and stops by name. A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__stop
tools.description: Lines, modes, facilities and child stops of a station. A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__stops-near
tools.description: Stations and stops within a radius of a point. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__journey
tools.description: Journey options between two places (postcodes, stop ids or "lat,lon"). A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__bike-points
tools.description: Every Santander Cycles docking station with live bike and space counts. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__bike-point
tools.description: Live bikes, e-bikes and empty docks at one station. A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__road-status
tools.description: Live status of major London road corridors. A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__road-disruption
tools.description: Current disruption on a road corridor, e.g. "a2", "a406". A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: london-transport__air-quality
tools.description: London air quality forecast for today and tomorrow. A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-road-safety__near
tools.description: Reported collisions within a radius (default 500 m, max 2 km) of a UK postcode or point over the last five years: totals by severity and year, and the most recent collisions with road, speed limit, light and weather. A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-road-safety__local-authority
tools.description: Five-year (or one-year) collision totals for a local authority district by severity and year, road class, speed limit, light, weather, surface and urban/rural. A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-road-safety__lsoa
tools.description: Collisions in a 2021 LSOA (neighbourhood of ~1,500 people) over five years, with the 50 most recent. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: uk-road-safety__collision
tools.description: One reported collision by its STATS19 index: date, time, severity, vehicles, casualties, road and conditions. A few free samples a day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: tides__stations-near
tools.description: NOAA tide-prediction stations within a radius (default 50 km) of a point, nearest first. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: tides__search
tools.description: Search NOAA tide stations by name and/or state. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: tides__station
tools.description: A station's location, time zone, products offered and tidal datums. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: tides__predictions
tools.description: Predicted high and low tide times (local) and heights for up to 7 days from today. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: tides__water-level
tools.description: Observed 6-minute water levels for the last hours (default 6, max 72) with the latest reading. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: tides__conditions
tools.description: Latest water temperature, air temperature, wind and air pressure reported at a station (whichever it measures). Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "uk-road-safety__local-authority" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
